body: Found while opening PR #313 (feat/vm-lab) from a session rooted outside this repo. The pr skill says the full field set, cardinalities, caps and title grammar live in `~/.claude/rules/common/git/pull-requests.md`. That path does not exist: `~/.claude` has no `rules` link, and the repo's `.claude/rules/common/` holds no `git/` folder. The PR still opened correctly because `pr.mjs` enforces the grammar itself through `pr-format.mjs` (types feat fix refactor docs test chore perf ci, optional scope of up to 16 lowercase characters, title at most 72 characters with no trailing period, values ASCII-only and at most 500 characters, at least one verified or not-verified line).U+000AU+000AHistory: `git log --diff-filter=D` shows the file was deleted in a700c9d1, "refactor(config): cut the always-on preamble from 51,740 to 6,423 bytes".U+000AU+000AOther references to the missing file found by grep, not yet assessed:U+000AU+002D `.claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh:131`, the deny message for ad-hoc PR creationU+000AU+002D `.claude/skills/conformance-auditor/reference/binding-rules.md:41`U+000AU+002D tests: `.claude/hooks/tests/block-destructive-bash.test.mjs` (lines 50, 426, 440, 580), `.claude/lib/git/tests/attribution-census.test.mjs:15`, `.claude/lib/git/tests/pr-format.test.mjs:321`, `.claude/lib/git/tests/no-self-merge-consent.test.mjs:155`U+000AU+000ASome test references may be intentional (for example, path-protection cases), so each needs checking before it is changed. Filed at the user's request and left parked; no work has started on it.
